text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Everyone's been in shock after that student criticized us for "running away" from the harsh reality of competition. Light Hello in particular has been taking it hard.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Concerned, I decide to check up on her. She wonders aloud whether she's just compensating for past regret at never getting to sing in a winning concert.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later, she apologizes in front of us, saying that the whole project was a mistake. However, Mihono Bourbon isn't convinced.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon chimes in too. For her, the Grand Concert is exciting because it presents a chance to convey her emotions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There could be more to the Grand Concert than even we realize. We decide to believe in that potential.
